subject: Slippage forensics and go-live derisking
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bloom <sara@helioshealth.com>, Dan Mercer <dan@helioshealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slippage forensics and go-live derisking

Hi Sara / Dan —

Thanks again for the sync earlier. I pulled together a short forensics snapshot and suggested derisking steps based on what we saw in the last two weeks of the MAP evaluation run. Attached: helios_map_v3.pdf (MAP with updated owners) and a compact risk log. Key points: 

- Current go-live target: 2027-06-23 (mutually agreed in April)
- Observed slippage: evaluation gate delays from Helios procurement (PO hold) + a late security evidence request. Net drift = ~14 business days.
- Highest risks: procurement hold (ProcureIT SLA mismatch), SOC evidence turnaround, and integration test flakiness for the nightly dataset.

Recommended short remediation (proposal):
1) Immediate: carve out a limited acceptance window (soft-lock) for internal integration tests only for the week of 2027-06-06 to preserve test progress.
2) Formal re-baseline: shift go-live to 2027-07-07 and propose two conditional buffers: (a) procurement clear by 2027-06-20, (b) SOC evidence sign-off by 2027-06-25. If both met earlier, we can move go-live earlier.
3) Compensation/assurance: offer a one-time credit to Helios for the delay window tied to acceptance milestones (details TBD with Sales Ops).

Actions I need from you:
- Sara: confirm whether ProcureIT can accelerate PO release and whether they will accept the revised acceptance carve-out (internal-only).
- Dan: confirm whether your security team can prioritize the evidence request; we can provide a snapshot export (security_evidence_snapshot.zip) by EOD Monday.

If we agree on the re-baseline today, I will circulate an updated MAP with explicit dates and responsibilities and loop in Legal/Sales Ops for the credit terms.

Thanks —
Priyom
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
priom_das@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: helios_map_v3.pdf (MAP draft), security_evidence_snapshot.zip (requested artifacts)
From: Sara Bloom <sara@helioshealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 08 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Slippage forensics and go-live derisking

Hi Priyom —

Appreciate the summary and recommended path. Short answers: 
- ProcureIT has flagged an internal vendor validation step that delayed PO execution; I have a call Monday 05/10 to escalate. I cannot guarantee the 06/20 procurement clear date but will push.
- Security: Dan and I reviewed. We will accept the security snapshot you can produce by Monday; final evidence will still require an internal review (target 06/22).

Helios is comfortable with a limited acceptance carve-out for internal testing as long as the external acceptance and payment tie to the re-baselined dates. Please share the MAP update and the credit proposal. 

Sara
VP Product Operations, Helios Health
Sara Bloom | sara@helioshealth.com

Folks — forwarding Priyom / Sara thread. My read and quick ops proposal: 

Summary of choices (trade-offs):
- Option A (conservative): Move go-live to 2027-07-07, offer a 5% one-time credit tied to verified acceptance completion by 2027-07-14. This buys Helios runway and keeps the account happy; downside: immediate ARR dilution and precedent.
- Option B (aggressive): Keep go-live 2027-06-23; offer a temporary limited acceptance window and an elevated delivery SLA for the first two weeks post go-live. Risk: higher chance of rollback cost and internal ops strain.

Operational asks if we choose Option A: 
- Sales Ops: draft credit terms and approval doc (I can own the exec sign-off).
- Solutions/Eng: prioritize the nightly tests flagged for flakiness; two engineers for the week of 05/17 to triage.
- Legal: prepare a short MAP amendment doc with conditional sign-off.

Priyom — I approve proceeding to offer Option A if Helios confirms the procurement timelines are unlikely to compress. Neha — please confirm you can greenlight the credit up to 5% and loop in Sales Ops. Marissa — FYI to prepare an updated win plan for the CSM.

-Jonas
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Sara / Dan —

Thanks for the quick answers. Attached is the updated MAP (helios_map_v3.pdf) and a short procurement timeline (procurement_timeline.xlsx) showing conditional gates. Summary of the MAP changes: 

- New target go-live: 2027-07-07 (conditional)
- Acceptance windows:
  • Integration tests (internal-only): 2027-06-06 -> 2027-06-10 (soft-lock)
  • External acceptance: 2027-06-28 -> 2027-07-05
- Contingency buffers: 10 business days after final SOC sign-off; procurement clear required by 2027-06-20 to maintain July 7 date.
- One-time credit: 5% credit applied to the first month invoice if we move to the re-baselined schedule (Sales Ops / Legal to formalize).

Please reply with a single-line approval if Helios accepts the revised MAP and the conditional credit. If we have approval I will: (1) push the amendment to Legal for signature, (2) ask Sales Ops to provision the credit, and (3) publish the MAP to the shared Drive link (below).

Shared MAP link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/helios/HW-4921/helios_map_v3.pdf

On a separate note, Dan — we will send the security snapshot (security_evidence_snapshot.zip) by EOD today for your review.

Thanks —
Priyom

Team —

Logging this thread into the account escalation ledger per our governance: Helios Health (HW-4921). Decision: approve Option A (re-baseline to 2027-07-07) and authorize a one-time 5% credit applied to the first month invoice contingent on executed MAP amendment and acceptance gates. 

Next operational steps I am authorizing now: 
- Sales Ops: create the credit memo and queue it for billing (Ops Finance copied).
- Legal: prepare the MAP amendment and triage signatures (Legal copied).
- Solutions Eng: allocate two triage engineers for the week of 2027-05-17 for nightly test stability.

I have also attached a short snapshot of evidence we provided to Helios (security_evidence_snapshot.zip) for the record. Priyom — please close the loop with Sara and request single-line sign-off from Helios on the revised MAP and the credit. Once Helios signs, we move to amendment execution.
